summary: Short, steep kerb at a junction, with no room clear of the lane.
reasons: Only 18 m, ends at a junction
Bush strip beside kerb, no pull-off

drivers.seclusion: Bush strip on the west side, pool house beyond; homes about 30 m away or more, but visible.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with a planted verge; no bay or shoulder, and the stretch runs into a main-road junction.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street joining a busier road at the south end.
drivers.convention: No parked campervans; a few cars parked further up the street.

flags: Only 18 m long, tight beside the junction
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the west edge; open to afternoon sun.
